//: Argus Presenter — LOCAL DEPLOYMENT CONFIG (Plan 0522 P16.1, R1). Copy to presenter-config.json (gitignored) or to ~/.config/argus-presenter/presenter-config.json, then edit. NO FILE IS REQUIRED: with none of them present the presenter runs on port 3000.
//resolution: First file found wins, whole file: $PRESENTER_CONFIG_FILE (must exist) > <repo>/presenter-config.json > ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/argus-presenter/presenter-config.json > built-in defaults. Loader: lib/deployment-config.mjs.
//presenterPort: The port the presenter binds — used by `node app/server.mjs` with no argument AND by the presenter_start MCP tool. It must match whatever your public ingress (tunnel/reverse proxy) forwards to, or the session is unreachable while every local check says 200. 0 = let the OS assign one.
